title: Sliding-window rate limiter admits one extra call

crosscheck.reference: reference limiter recomputing the live admitted set from the expiry rule each call

cases.name: v4:limit_two_burst
cases.code:
rl = sol.RateLimiter(2, 10)
result = [rl.allow(0), rl.allow(1), rl.allow(2), rl.allow(3)]

cases.name: v4:expiry_at_exactly_window
cases.code:

out = [rl.allow(0), rl.allow(1), rl.allow(2), rl.allow(10)]
result = (out, rl.calls)

cases.name: v4:calls_invariant_step_by_step
cases.code:
rl = sol.RateLimiter(2, 5)
steps = []
for t in [0, 1, 2, 3, 5, 6, 7, 11]:
    ok = rl.allow(t)
    steps.append((t, ok, list(rl.calls), type(rl.calls).__name__))
result = steps

cases.name: v4:higher_limit_sliding
cases.code:
rl = sol.RateLimiter(3, 10)
out = []
for t in [0, 2, 4, 6, 9, 10, 12, 14, 20]:
    out.append((t, rl.allow(t), len(rl.calls)))
result = out

cases.name: burst_same_timestamp
cases.code:
out = []
for m, w, ts in [(3, 10, [5, 5, 5, 5, 5, 15, 15, 15, 15])]:
    rl = sol.RateLimiter(m, w)
    steps = []
    for t in ts:
        ok = rl.allow(t)
        steps.append((ok, list(rl.calls), type(rl.calls).__name__))
    out.append((steps, rl.max_calls, rl.window))
result = out
